title: Apply for the NSW Spectacles Program
summary: Find out if you are eligible for and how to apply for the NSW Spectacles Program, which provides free glasses and vision aids to financially disadvantaged NSW residents.
intro:
The NSW Spectacles Program provides free glasses and vision aids to financially disadvantaged NSW residents.

If you're eligible, you can receive free of charge in any 2-year period:

Contact lenses, tinted lenses or low vision aids may be provided in certain circumstances.
who_can_apply: Must be an Australian permanent resident living in NSW.
Must receive a full Centrelink pension or income support payment, and receive no other income other than the Centrelink payment.
Must be a low-wage earner who earns less than the specified amount.
Must have financial assets less than $500 (if single) or $1,000 (if married/partnered, or with dependents).
Must not be eligible for any other spectacles subsidy schemes.

faqs.q: What does the NSW Spectacles Program provide?
faqs.a: The program provides free glasses and vision aids to financially disadvantaged NSW residents. Depending on circumstances, contact lenses or tinted lenses may also be provided.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the program?
faqs.a: Applicants must be an Australian permanent resident living in NSW. Eligibility also depends on income, financial assets, and not being eligible for other spectacles subsidy schemes.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the NSW Spectacles Program?
faqs.a: To apply, you must check the eligibility requirements, select 'Find out more', and follow the application process steps.
